notes: YOK-26 first pass, every number proposed for the Sparring Partner to tune. A newcomer on Kihon (K2): sees the screen 24 ticks late (P6: only on-screen state, never the opponent's buttons), decides every 8 ticks, presses a random normal whatever the range on 15% of its decisions (mistake), puts its guard up (standing only) for 50% of the threats it sees (a swing or a projectile, rolled once each, held while the threat lasts) holds a standing guard (back) through 50% of its waits and in-range walks (idle_guard_pct, YOK-155: every strike normal hits inside its 24-tick reaction, so only a guard already up blocks one; 0 = the YOK-26 bot) and anti-airs 15% of jumps with heavy punch. Specials are Special + direction (neutral A, forward B, back C, down D). Route: the dojo when one is reachable (R4's newcomer heal@4 + rest@7 line), else a seeded random pick. Rewards: an upgrade first, then a new special, then a modifier; a card with several targets goes on the lowest slot. Merchant: the free heal; dojo: rest. There is no round timer (designer 2026-10-21, YOK-179): fights go to KO. max_fight_ticks is only a safety cap, 108000 ticks = 30 minutes, ten times the old 3-minute cap, so it never decides a normal fight; a fight it stops is reported as a stall, not a loss, and the run ends there. menu_seconds_per_node is the time outside fights per node for the run-length estimate (R9). Merchant plans: heal, shop (buy shelf commons through the shop, YOK-95, never release), heal_if_hurt_else_shop (with heal_below_pct), skip; the default heals (R4). PROVISIONAL until the designer rules (YOK-36, decision log 'YOK-26 harness'): menu_seconds_per_node 45, and per-run AI and bot seeds derived from the run seed (batch seeds base..base+n-1, base 1).
